documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, 27Th October, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 16Th October 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue reaching INR2,013 crores and operating PAT crossing INR100 crores. The company's strategic focus on lightweight jewelry, advanced manufacturing, design capabilities, and higher-margin studded and Advance Gold products drove gross margin expansion and positive operating cash flows of approximately INR30 crores. Furthermore, management reaffirmed its long-term strategic road map, including Vision 2030 targets and ongoing efforts in international market expansion and corporate governance. Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited reported robust financial growth for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching ₹2,012.8 crore and PAT surging to ₹104.9 crore. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to approximately ₹8,100 crore, alongside expectations of higher EBITDA and PAT margins driven by value-added products and the advance gold model.

guidance.claim: The company remains firmly on track to achieve its revenue aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue projection upwards to approximately ₹8,100 crore.
For FY27, the EBITDA margin is expected to be in the range of 7.0% to 7.5%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: The PAT margin for FY27 is guided at 4.5% to 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to reach approximately ₹18,000 to ₹19,000 crore.
The company targets a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35% and projects a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Target growth metrics. We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management stated that top line expansion is intentionally capped at 30% to 35% to further strengthen the balance sheet.
guidance.quote: Therefore, top line expansion is intentionally capped at 30% to 35% to further strengthening the balance sheet.

guidance.claim: The model targets a consistent conversion of 20% to 25% of PAT into operating cash flow.
guidance.quote: Our model targets a consistent conversion of 20% to 25% of PAT into operating cash flow, underscoring a lean, high velocity growth engine that is rare among high- growth Indian enterprises.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030.
guidance.quote: While these levers offer strong upside, we have guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, which represents an expansion of 75 basis points from current levels.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30 with a nil net debt position.
guidance.quote: as we advance towards our FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-22 karat jewelry has gained market share due to appreciation in gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's participation in the Asiana U.K. India Jewellery Expo resulted in a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they have not found any lowering of orders or softening of demand at the B2B level due to lightweight jewellery focus.
demand_outlook.quote: And nowadays retailers have announced so many gold exchange schemes and with gold exchange, they will get more benefit in the making charges. Many schemes are rolled out. We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above. The regular rate is 20% gold exchange business, it has gone to 40%.

demand_outlook.claim: Large corporate customers and owners indicate it is very early to predict in one week and are analyzing June and July consumer behavior.
demand_outlook.quote: And again, by talking to our large customers, large corporate pool and the owners with them I'm talking to, they are also telling it is very early to predict in 1 week. So they are analyzing June month, July month, how the consumer behavior is going to happen.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that diamond jewellery is picking up because of gold rates.
demand_outlook.quote: So again diamond jewellery is picking up because of the gold rates and all the diamond jewellery, we are at 1.5%.

capex_expansion.claim: Future facility expansion will continue on a leased model with an estimated capex of INR80 crores to INR100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing footprint has expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects to monetize land and encash it by August or September end.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies also. We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it. And so we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies for the same purpose also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, representing 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The share of value-added business surged from under 10% in FY23 to approximately 50-55% in FY26, acting as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Implementation of an enterprise ERP system led to a reduction in gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.
margins_costs.quote: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45% year-to-date, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: From the current year-to-date, our consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.

margins_costs.claim: Interest expenses account for 1.25% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: Today, interest expenses account for 1.25% of sales, which is a significant drag.

margins_costs.claim: The FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Our FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is close to 55% to 57% and the company has room of 40%.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

orders_capacity.claim: The company did around 650 kgs per month in Q4, which is in line with guidance.
orders_capacity.quote: Siddharth Sipani: We would like to just inform that in the last Q4, we have done around 650 kgs per month, and that is in line with our guidance that we have provided.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly capacity utilisation is at 55% based on 1.2-ton capacity and 650 kg exit.
orders_capacity.quote: Mangesh Chauhan: So again, 1.2-ton capacity we have, we are 650 kg last quarter exit. So, we have a 55% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter is INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27 onwards, taking payouts solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt will be reduced by over 50% in FY27 through land sale and operational improvement.
capital_allocation.quote: We would be reducing net debt by 50% above in FY27 itself through land sale and operational improvement.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividends will be funded strictly out of operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital distribution discipline: Dividends will be funded strictly out of operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital days dropped from 71 days for the quarter ended March '25 to 59 days for the quarter ended March '26.
capital_allocation.quote: And our net working capital days have successfully dropped from 71 days for quarter ended March '25 to 59 days for this quarter ended March 26.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that gold metal loan is very much costlier as per the cost compared to local market prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Right now, gold metal loan is very much costlier as per the cost, not, as per the interest rate. So, we are at zero gold metal loan right now.

management_commitments.claim: The company will revise its FY27 revenue guidance after Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to purchasing a specific property if the sale process were not completed within the stipulated timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: If the sale process were not completed within the stipulated timeframe, the promoters themselves would purchase this property.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach 52 working capital days by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets an average of 15% Advance Gold business for the current year, 20% next year, and 25% in the third year.
management_commitments.quote: and we have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, with payouts solely through dividends.
management_commitments.quote: promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: Growth will be funded strictly through internal cash generation to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a net debt reduction of over 50% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: I repeat there would be a debt reduction of over 50% in FY27 itself.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: as we advance towards our FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
